RETROSPECTIVE ARCHITECTURE DECISION · 11 OCTOBER 2026

ADR-0012: Separate denial, live purge and retained-storage disposal

Status

Accepted; live-copy cleanup implemented

Context

Deleting current SQL rows does not erase MVCC/WAL, backups, caches, audit or offline copies.

Decision

Expose authority enforcement, live-copy cleanup and retained-surface disposal as distinct milestones. Keep durable fences after purge and quarantine restores until current policy is applied.

Alternatives

Declare regulatory erasure immediately after SQL DELETE; remove fences with the payload.

Consequences

COMPLETE in the migration lab means only the documented live fixture surfaces. Legal holds, encryption-key scope and backup lifecycle require separate decisions and evidence.

Evidence

MIGRATION.md; DESIGN.md; design/src/entity_update.py

Gate

Inventory every persistent surface, demonstrate restore fencing and record lawful deadline exceptions.
